ev_0007.summary: Labelled vertices A(47,65), D(441,65), B(47,300), C(441,300), E(138,107) are taken from the supervisor's verified letters. Rectangle sides AD, BC, AB, DC are confirmed edges by detect_lines (AB and DC are detected only to y~254, so their lower ends are connected to B and C by label-edge inference). E lies on the C-line: the C-to-E direction matches the C-to-(116,93) fit within about 1 px, so E is on segment CE. The continuation from E to (116,93) is a candidate overshoot or real continuation and cannot be settled from CV alone. A verified square right-angle mark sits at E between the C-E line and the E-B edge, but measured directions give about 97 degrees, not 90, which is a conflict. The line A-E (seg_07) is collinear with A and E within about 1 px but stops about 8 px short of A; it is a candidate edge. The circle centre (244,258), radius 199, is unlabeled. Its top crosses AD at about (198,65) and (290,65). Its left and right extremes come near AB and DC, so it may be tangent to thos
